description: This file defines the VerticalLabelUI class, a custom UI delegate for vertically oriented labels in Swing. It extends BasicLabelUI to support rotated text and icons, providing a custom paint method to render labels vertically with optional clockwise rotation.

classes.name: VerticalLabelUI
classes.description: A custom Swing UI delegate for vertical labels that supports rotation of text and icons for vertical display.

methods.name: VerticalLabelUI
methods.description: Constructor initializing the UI with optional clockwise rotation.

methods.name: getPreferredSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size, with width and height swapped to accommodate vertical orientation.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Custom paint method handling rotation transform and rendering of label's icon and text vertically.
